verdict.rationale: Docs repeatedly state pay-as-you-go, per-token pricing with no contracts or sales required (docs-12, docs-16, docs-24, docs-31), strongly implying self-serve access to prices, and the model catalog is enumerable via a keyless API (deepinfra-probe-rt-1). However, no evidence pack item shows an actual public price list or per-model $/token table a founder could browse. missing for 10: explicit citation of a pricing page or API field listing per-token prices for each hosted model, independent confirmation that prices are visible without account/sales contact.
